nodes.label: Non-negotiable: Java 25 + Quarkus 3.31
nodes.rationale: Java 25 required; Quarkus 3.31 adds full Java 25 runtime + native image support. Older 3.20 needed Java 21 (Byte Buddy rejected JDK 25). .sdkmanrc pins 25.0.2-zulu.

nodes.label: Non-negotiable: Flyway Owns DDL (Hibernate validate only)
nodes.rationale: quarkus.hibernate-orm.database.generation=validate. Never let Hibernate auto-DDL. Migrations under backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V*.sql.

nodes.label: Non-negotiable: State Machine Guards in ServiceOrderStateMachine
nodes.rationale: ServiceOrderStateMachine is source of truth for transitions. SCHEDULED requires non-null mechanic, start+end, non-overlapping window. Override endpoint is the only bypass (CANCELLED/REQUESTED targets only).

nodes.label: Non-negotiable: DevResource gated by @IfBuildProfile(dev)
nodes.rationale: /api/dev/* only accessible in dev profile. Do not call from prod-style code paths.

nodes.label: Non-negotiable: Client FK Rules (Reservation NOT NULL, ServiceOrder nullable)
nodes.rationale: Reservation.client_id is NOT NULL — creating without clientId returns 400. ServiceOrder.client_id is nullable but UI's order-creation form requires it.
